title: AegisPT Safe-Click Browser Copilot
goal: Build an enterprise browser extension that intercepts user clicks on untrusted links. AegisPT's AI instantly visits the link in a headless sandbox, analyzes the page for credential harvesting (e.g., fake Microsoft login), and blocks the user if malicious.
scope: Browser extension (Chrome/Edge), API endpoint for synchronous sandbox evaluation, and real-time visual feedback.
generation_reason: Provide real-time 'point-of-click' protection against zero-day phishing campaigns that bypass traditional email filters.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: The sandbox evaluation must complete in under 1500ms to avoid disrupting user experience.

success_criteria: AegisPT backend safely renders the target URL.
AI correctly identifies an obfuscated phishing page and blocks navigation.

acceptance_criteria: Headless rendering and AI classification logic functions correctly and securely.
